names: names: each control has the name that the page shows, and each bar tells its times
keyboard: the trace is 1 tab stop, and only the top span shows at first
keyboard: ArrowDown and ArrowUp move through the shown spans, and Home and End go to the ends
keyboard: ArrowRight opens a span, ArrowLeft closes it and then goes to the parent
keyboard: Enter and Space select a span, and the line tells when it starts and how long it takes
keyboard: Enter on Expand all spans opens each span, and Collapse all spans closes them
agent: an agent expands the spans and selects a span that was hidden
agent: a span that is not in the trace changes nothing on the page
